description: Lists everything recorded in the person's health timeline, grouped by kind (symptom, med, vital, sleep, lab, message) and exact name, with entry counts and first/last dates. Call this first to learn the exact names other tools expect.

configuration.query: FROM health-timeline | STATS entries = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY kind, name | SORT kind ASC, entries DESC
